sections.shortTitle: Chief Martial Law Administrator Regulation 1979 No 43
sections.section: RGLN. - Chief Martial Law Administrator Regulation 1979, No. 43
sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
MARTIAL LAW REGULATIONS
By
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW
ADMINISTRATOR
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st January 1979]
No. 43
1.
In Martial Law Regulation No. 30, hereinafter referred to as the said
Regulation, in paragraph 2, in sub-paragraph (b), the bracket and figure
"(1)" after the word "Explanation" shall be omitted.
2.
In the said Regulation, in paragraph 2, in sub-paragraph (b), the existing
Explanation (2) shall be omitted.
3.
In the said Regulation, in paragraph 2, after sub-paragraph (b), the following
new sub-paragraph (c) shall be inserted, namely :-
"(c) Sell, purchase, re-claim, re-condition or
refine used lubricating oils without the prior permission, in writing, of the
Federal Government under the Pakistan Petroleum (Refining, Blending and
Marketing) Rules, 1971."
4.
In the said Regulation, after paragraph 3, the following new paragraph 3-A
shall be inserted, namely :-
"3-A. The Federal Government may make rules for
carrying out the purposes of this Regulation and may avail for this purpose the
Pakistan Petroleum (Refining, Blending and Marketing) Rules, 1971 so far as the
said :<4. Rules are not inconsistent with provisions of this
Regulation".
